results.title: President Lee appoints special counsel to investigate June 3 ballot shortages
results.description: President Lee Jae Myung appointed Lee Tae-han as special counsel to investigate ballot shortages and alleged election mismanagement during South Korea's June 3 elections.

results.title: Pak top court orders Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
results.description: Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered the transfer of incarcerated former Prime Minister Imran Khan to a private hospital for a medical examination concerning an eye ailment. This directive comes despite jail authorities claiming his eyesight was 'almost normal,' following petitions from his legal team expressing dissatisfaction with government hospital treatment.
